verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims it can "automate GL coding by entity globally" and ties this to closing the books daily. That covers the automatic, cross-entity GL-coding and close-acceleration parts of the story. The evidence is only two short marketing lines, and neither says the GL coding is AI-driven; the AI framing comes only from Brex's general positioning. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the GL coding is AI-powered, documentation of how codes are assigned and reviewed across entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close
